paite: Paul, Pathian thupiak bang a i hondampa leh i lamet Toupa Jesu Khrist sawltak in;
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

paite: ginna a ka ta taktak Timothi kiang ah, i Pa Pathian, leh i Toupa Khrist Jesu a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna na tung ah om hen.
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

paite: Masidonia gam a ka hoh dek lai a ka hon nget bang in Ephesa ah om gige in, huchi a mi khenkhat gindan tuam sinsak lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
heading: Sinsakmi Takloute
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

paite: Huan Pathian lam a phattuamna, ginna a om pen hilou, kiselna leh gintak thu gen omsak lel tangthu leh khangthu sui zoh louh peuh buaipih lou ding a na hilhtheihna ding in.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

paite: Eite'n thuhilh ding i kep pen bel lungtang siangthou leh sia-le-pha theihna siang leh ginna taktak a kipan a pawt itna ahi zaw hi.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

paite: Mi khenkhatte'n hiaite pialsan in thugina lou genna lam ah avakmang uhi.
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

paite: Athugen uh leh thil ahi a agente uh leng bang ahia chih theiloupi in dan sinsak mite hih a-ut uhi.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

paite: Mi'n azat hoihleh dan ahoih chih i thei uhi.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

paite: Ahi a, dan zaw midiktatte a ding a bawl ahi kei a, dan kalhte leh dan lou a omte a ding, Pathian limsakloute leh mikhialte, misiangthouloute leh Pathian zahloute, pate thatte, nute thatte, mihing thatte;
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

paite: kingaihhatte, tawkohukte, mihing gute, zuautheite, kichiam khemkhemte a ding leh thil dang thugin toh kituak lou himhimte a ding leh,
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

paite: ka kiang a kepsak a om Pathian tanchinhoih thupi hilhna dik kalhte a ding ahi.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

paite: Ahon hihhatpa Khrist Jesu i Toupa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen hi, muanhuai ahon sak a, anasempa dia ahon chih tak ziak in.
heading: Pathian Zahngaihna Ziak A Kipahna
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

paite: Tuma lam in Pathian gensepa leh sawipa leh hihsepa na hita mah leng; gingtaloupi leh theiloupi a hih ka hih ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh tak.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

paite: Huan i Toupa hehpihna ginna leh Khrist Jesu a itna in nakpitak in adimletta hi.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

paite: Khrist Jesu khialte hondam ding in khovel ah ahong pai chih ataksanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi. Alak ua khialpen ka hi.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

paite: Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi zahngaihna ka na muh; Jesu Khrist in adohzohna kim a khialpen keimah a alatsak theihna ding ahi, tuban siah tangtawn hinna muhna ding a amah hon gingta dingte a dia etsakna hi ding in.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

paite: Kumpipa tangtawn a om, sithei lou, muh theih louh, Pathian tak kia, tangtawn in zahtak leh thupi in om hen, Amen.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ka tapa Timothi aw, na tungtang genkholhnate toh kituak in hiai mohpuakna leh thuhilhna ka hon pia hi, huchi a huai thute hilh a, kidouna hoih na dou theihna ding in,
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

paite: ginna leh sia-le-pha theihna siangtak len tinten in, mi khenkhatte'n huai sia-le-pha theihna paikhia in ginna lam ah long sia bang in akekseta uhi.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

paite: Huaite lak ah Himenaias leh Alexander apang uhi; Pathian agensiatlouhna ding un amaute Setan ka peta hi.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
